[Problem]{.card-kicker} **Frequency Tracker** [LC 2671 · Frequency Tracker](https://leetcode.com/problems/frequency-tracker/){difficulty="Medium"}

The query is about a *count*, not about a number, so index by the count: next to `freq[x]` (how often `x` occurs) keep `cnt[f]`, how many numbers occur exactly `f` times. A change of one number's frequency from $f$ to $f \pm 1$ moves one unit from `cnt[f]` to `cnt[f ± 1]`, and `hasFrequency(f)` is `cnt[f] > 0`. That second counter, indexed by the values of the first, is the smallest counter of counters (@sec-ds-a3).

[Solved in full in @sec-ds-p3-freqtracker.]{.card-link}

:::
